title_en: is it … ? / have you … ? / do they … ? etc. (questions 1)
title_vi: is it … ? / have you … ? / do they … ? v.v. (câu hỏi 1)
theory_html:
A. The first verb is before the subject

A. Động từ đầu tiên đứng trước chủ ngữ

  • You are eating. → Are you eating? / What are you eating?

    Bạn đang ăn. → Bạn đang ăn à? / Bạn đang ăn gì?

In questions, the first verb (is / are / have etc.) is before the subject:

Trong câu hỏi, động từ đầu tiên (is / are / have v.v.) đứng trước chủ ngữ:

positive (subject + verb)
khẳng định (chủ ngữ + động từ)		question (verb + subject)
câu hỏi (động từ + chủ ngữ)
I am late.Am I late?
That seat is free.Is that seat free?
She was angry.Why was she angry?
David has gone.Where has David gone?
You have got a car.Have you got a car?
They will be here soon.When will they be here?
Paula can swim.Can Paula swim?

Remember: the subject is after the first verb.

Ghi nhớ: chủ ngữ đứng sau động từ đầu tiên.

  • Where has David gone? (not Where has gone David?)

    David đi đâu rồi? (không nói Where has gone David?)

  • Are those people waiting for something? (not Are waiting … ?)

    Những người kia đang đợi gì à? (không nói Are waiting … ?)

  • When was the telephone invented? (not When was invented … ?)

    Điện thoại được phát minh khi nào? (không nói When was invented … ?)

B. do … ? / does … ? / did … ?

Present simple questions: do I/we/you/they, does he/she/it + work/live/go etc. …? Past simple questions: did I/they/he/she etc. …?

Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn: do I/we/you/they, does he/she/it + work/live/go v.v. …? Câu hỏi quá khứ đơn: did I/they/he/she v.v. …?

positive
khẳng định		question
câu hỏi
They work hard.Do they work hard?
You watch television.How often do you watch television?
Chris works hard.Does Chris work hard?
She gets up early.What time does she get up?
They worked hard.Did they work hard?
You had dinner.What did you have for dinner?
She got up early.What time did she get up?

Sometimes do is the main verb (do you do / did he do etc.):

Đôi khi do là động từ chính (do you do / did he do v.v.):

  • What do you usually do at weekends?

    Cuối tuần bạn thường làm gì?

  • A: What does your brother do? B: He works in a bank.

    A: Anh trai bạn làm nghề gì? B: Anh ấy làm ở ngân hàng.

  • A: I broke my finger last week. B: How did you do that? (not How did you that?)

    A: Tuần trước tôi bị gãy ngón tay. B: Sao bạn bị vậy? (không nói How did you that?)

C. Why isn’t … ? / Why don’t … ? etc. (Why + negative)

C. Why isn’t … ? / Why don’t … ? v.v. (Why + phủ định)

  • Where’s John? Why isn’t he here? (not Why he isn’t here?)

    John đâu? Sao anh ấy không ở đây? (không nói Why he isn’t here?)

  • Why can’t Paula come to the meeting tomorrow? (not Why Paula can’t … ?)

    Sao Paula không thể đến họp ngày mai? (không nói Why Paula can’t … ?)

  • Why didn’t you phone me last night?

    Sao tối qua bạn không gọi cho tôi?

Điểm ngữ pháp: Không nói How did you that?
mcq.key: A: I broke my finger last week. B: How ___ that?|did you do

mcq.question: Where’s John? Why ___ here?
mcq.full: Where’s John? Why isn’t he here?
mcq.vi: John đâu? Sao anh ấy không ở đây?
mcq.expl:
Why + negative auxiliary + subject (Why isn’t he …? / Why didn’t you …?).
Why + trợ động từ phủ định + chủ ngữ (Why isn’t he …? / Why didn’t you …?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Why + isn’t + he (không nói Why he isn’t).
mcq.key: Where’s John? Why ___ here?|isn’t he

mcq.question: Why ___ come to the meeting tomorrow?

Điểm ngữ pháp: Why + can’t + Paula.
mcq.key: Why ___ come to the meeting tomorrow?|can’t Paula
